Extract one modality from a Fitbit archive

Source: R/io-fitbit.R
fitbitSeries.Rd

Extract one modality from a Fitbit archive

Usage

fitbitSeries(x, modality)

Arguments

x

A fitbit object from readFitbit().

modality

One of the modality names present in x (e.g. "heart_rate", "spo2", "sleep").

Value

The modality's data frame.

See also

readFitbit()
